item.title: Multimodal data annotation: the infrastructure layer behind today’s AI
item.description:
Date: January 02, 2026
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Machine Learning", "Data Annotation", "Multimodal Data", "AI Infrastructure"]
Summary:
  • Multimodal data annotation is crucial for AI development.
  • It involves labeling diverse data types like text, images, and audio.
  • This process improves machine learning model accuracy.
  • Infrastructure supports efficient and scalable annotation workflows.
  • Advances in tools enhance annotation quality and speed.
